name: popsicle
headline: InstaReact: Instagram Automation Bot
short_description: Selenium-based console application that automates Instagram engagement through likes, follows, and comments on posts matching specified hashtags.
author: ReneKleinfrau

sections.overview:
InstaReact is a Selenium-based automation tool designed for Instagram engagement. It enables users to automatically like, follow, and comment on posts based on customizable hashtags and probability settings. The application runs as a console program and supports Chrome profile persistence to maintain login sessions. Users configure behavior through VB.NET settings including engagement percentages, hashtag targets, and comment templates. XPath-based selectors allow updates as Instagram's interface evolves.
Automate engagement on Instagram posts matching specific hashtags
Increase follower count through targeted follow automation
Generate consistent comments on posts in relevant niches
Test Instagram automation workflows with configurable probabilities
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/ReneKleinfrau/InstaReact`
sections.usage:
```
Act as an Instagram bot for [COMPANY] in the [INDUSTRY] sector. Automate the following actions: Like 20 posts per day from accounts that use [HASHTAG1] and [HASHTAG2], follow 10 new accounts per day that engage with these hashtags, and comment on 5 posts per day with one of these pre-approved messages: ['Great content!', 'Love this post!', 'Inspiring!', 'This is awesome!']. Run this automation for 30 days and provide a summary report.
```
